newsitem.title: UK: CWC, TeleWest up on merger report.
newsitem.headline: CWC, TeleWest up on merger report.

text.p: Shares in Cable & Wireless Communications Plc and Telewest Communications Plc rose in early trading on Tuesday after a press report said the two companies were in talks that could lead to a merger.
CWC shares were up 18-1/2p at 322 by 0707 GMT while TeleWest shares were up 13p at 105.

The Times newspaper said the two groups were in talks to form a common television and phone brand that could lead to a merger, increasing their ability to compete with British Telecommunications Plc and British Sky Broadcasting Plc
The Times quoted TeleWest chairman Fred Vierra as saying that the two firms were in co-operation talks. "We cannot rule out a full merger as a possibility down the road," he told the paper.

No-one at CWC, which gained a separate stock market quotation in April following its creation from the Cable & Wireless Plc unit Mercury and three cable TV groups, was immediately available for comment.
General Cable Plc shares were also dragged higher by the report, up 12-1/2p at 175-1/2.
